Data Product & Metadata Governance Assistant Manager
22 set 2026
We don’t imagine a better future. We’re building it!
Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché supporto nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.
Nel particolare, entrerai a far parte del Team di Lighthouse di Milano.
La Lighthouse è il centro di eccellenza di KPMG Advisory che offre soluzioni di Data & Analytics sul mercato.
Sarai impegnato nel fornire soluzioni tecnologiche all'avanguardia, tra cui algoritmi la business intelligence, la visualizzazione dei dati, l'analisi avanzata, il process mining e le tecnologie di machine learning per migliorare il processo decisionale umano.
Nello specifico, lavorerai nel team Data & AI e contribuirai alla progettazione, realizzazione e messa in produzione di soluzioni avanzate lungo l’intero ciclo di vita del dato e dei modelli. In particolare ti occuperai di:
Implementazione e configurazione di Data Catalog/Data Marketplace, con esperienza in tecnologie quali Atlan, Zeenea, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Alation, Informatica EDC/IDMC, DataHub, OpenMetadata.
Modellazione e gestione dei metadata, inclusi Business Glossary, Business Terms, metadata model, ownership, stewardship, lineage, classification e certification.
Supporto al disegno e alla messa a terra dei processi di Data Governance, traducendo ruoli, responsabilità, policy e processi in workflow e configurazioni operative all'interno degli strumenti di governance.
Metadatazione e gestione del lifecycle dei Data Product, incluse la definizione di domain, owner, input/output port, SLA/SLO, policy, lifecycle status e delle relazioni tra asset, con conoscenza degli approcci Data Mesh / Data Products e, preferibilmente, degli strumenti quali Atlan, Zeenea, DataHub, OpenMetadata, Witboost. Zeenea, ad esempio, dispone oggi di capability specifiche per la gestione e la discovery dei Data Product.
Configurazione di workflow, ruoli, stewardship e integrazioni applicative tramite REST API, webhook, Python e SQL, inclusa l'integrazione con sistemi di Identity & Access Management, quali Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, e con i principali ecosistemi di Data Platform.
Data Contract e metadata automation, con conoscenza di Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS), YAML/JSON, gestione dei contratti machine-readable e automazione della produzione, validazione e sincronizzazione dei metadata.
Data Quality e Data Observability, con esperienza o conoscenza di strumenti quali dbt, Soda e Great Expectations, per integrare regole, quality check, risultati dei controlli e relativi metadati nel ciclo di vita degli asset e dei Data Product.
Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche
Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:
Hai un profilo tecnico “ibrido”, con competenze distribuite su più aree del dominio Data & AI e livelli di profondità differenti in funzione dell’ambito (engineering, analytics AI, platforms), con l’obiettivo di crescere.
Hai avuto almeno un’esperienza di gestione tecnica di progettualità di delivery Data& AI sia essa da team lead, delivery lead o tutor di colleghi più giovani.
Hai maturato almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza di lavoro nella gestione di progetti complessi e team tecnici;
Possiedi competenze sulle seguenti aree:
1. Data Engineering, Data Management & Visual Analytics
Solida conoscenza di SQL e dei principali database e motori analitici (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery).
Esperienza nella progettazione e realizzazione di pipeline dati ETL / ELT e nella modellazione dei dati per uso analitico.
Conoscenza dei principali principi di data management: data modelling, data quality, metadata & lineage, architetture lakehouse e cloud-native.
Familiarità con framework di orchestrazione e pipeline moderne (dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Fabric Pipelines).
Esperienza con ambienti distribuiti e tecnologie big data (Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Kafka / Pub-Sub).
Esperienza nell’integrazione dei livelli di serving e visualizzazione (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, Looker) come parte integrante delle pipeline dati e dei layer semantici.
2. Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning & AI
Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle principali librerie per analisi, machine learning e data processing.
Esperienza nello sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning e soluzioni di Advanced Analytics applicate a casi di business reali.
Familiarità con tematiche di AI generativa e NLP: integrazione di modelli foundation (OpenAI, Claude, Hugging Face), progettazione di soluzioni RAG, prompt engineering.
Prime esperienze di industrializzazione dei modelli (MLflow, API REST, versioning, monitoring, MLOps).
Attenzione ai temi di explainability, affidabilità, sicurezza e governance dell’AI.
3. Cloud & Modern Data Platforms
Conoscenza pratica di almeno un grande provider cloud (preferibilmente Azure, in alternativa AWS o GCP).
Esperienza nell’uso di servizi nativi per analytics, data engineering e AI (Databricks, Fabric, Synapse, Azure ML, BigQuery, Snowflake).
Capacità di progettare soluzioni scalabili, performanti e cost-efficient su piattaforme cloud-native.
Nice to have:
conoscenza di Git, GitHub/GitLab/Azure DevOps, version control e pipeline CI/CD , con particolare riferimento alla gestione versionata dei metadati, Data Contract, configuration-as-code e controlli automatizzati.
Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG
Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità;
Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra;
Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale;
Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati;
Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative;
Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico.
Inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio, RAL indicativa compresa tra € 38.000 e € 51.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi con riferimento specifico alle competenze e all’esperienza del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.
Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno
Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale.
Grazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415, sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125, relativa alla parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni concrete che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (ESG).
Unisciti a noi!
We don’t imagine a better future. We’re building it!
Would you like to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and your colleagues address and solve today’s most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory provides consulting services to companies, supporting them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitalization, risk analysis and management, as well as extraordinary finance transactions.
Specifically, you will join the Lighthouse Team in Milan .
Lighthouse is the KPMG Advisory Centre of Excellence that delivers Data & Analytics solutions to the market.
You will be involved in delivering cutting-edge technology solutions, including algorithms, business intelligence, data visualization, advanced analytics, process mining and machine learning technologies to improve human decision-making.
More specifically, you will work within the Data & AI team and contribute to the design, implementation and production deployment of advanced solutions across the entire data and model lifecycle. In particular, you will be responsible for:
Implementation and configuration of Data Catalog/Data Marketplace solutions , with experience in technologies such as Atlan, Zeenea, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Alation, Informatica EDC/IDMC, DataHub and OpenMetadata .
Metadata modelling and management , including Business Glossary, Business Terms, metadata models, ownership, stewardship, lineage, classification and certification .
Supporting the design and implementation of Data Governance processes , translating roles, responsibilities, policies and processes into workflows and operational configurations within governance tools.
Metadata management and Data Product lifecycle management , including the definition of domains, owners, input/output ports, SLA/SLOs, policies, lifecycle statuses and relationships between assets , with knowledge of Data Mesh / Data Products approaches and, preferably, tools such as Atlan, Zeenea, DataHub, OpenMetadata and Witboost . For example, Zeenea currently provides specific capabilities for Data Product management and discovery.
Configuration of workflows, roles, stewardship processes and application integrations through REST APIs, webhooks, Python and SQL , including integration with Identity & Access Management systems , such as Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD , and with major Data Platform ecosystems.
Data Contracts and metadata automation , with knowledge of the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS), YAML/JSON , machine-readable contract management, and automation of metadata generation, validation and synchronization.
Data Quality and Data Observability , with experience or knowledge of tools such as dbt, Soda and Great Expectations , to integrate rules, quality checks, control results and related metadata into the lifecycle of assets and Data Products.
Come As You Are – Your Skills and Characteristics
This opportunity is perfect for you if:
You have a hybrid technical profile , with skills distributed across multiple areas of the Data & AI domain and different levels of depth depending on the area ( engineering, analytics/AI, platforms ), with the goal of continuing to grow.
You have had at least one experience in technical management of Data & AI delivery projects , whether as a team lead, delivery lead or mentor/tutor for junior colleagues .
You have gained at least 4–5 years of professional experience managing complex projects and technical teams .
You have skills in the following areas:
1. Data Engineering, Data Management & Visual Analytics
Strong knowledge of SQL and major databases and analytical engines ( PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery ).
Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT data pipelines and data modelling for analytical purposes .
Knowledge of key data management principles , including data modelling, data quality, metadata & lineage, lakehouse architectures and cloud-native architectures .
Familiarity with modern orchestration and pipeline frameworks ( dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Fabric Pipelines ).
Experience with distributed environments and big data technologies ( Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Kafka / Pub-Sub ).
Experience integrating serving and visualization layers ( Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, Looker ) as an integral part of data pipelines and semantic layers.
2. Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning & AI
Excellent knowledge of Python and the main libraries for data analysis, machine learning and data processing .
Experience developing Machine Learning models and Advanced Analytics solutions applied to real-world business use cases.
Familiarity with Generative AI and NLP , including the integration of foundation models ( OpenAI, Claude, Hugging Face ), RAG solution design and prompt engineering .
Initial experience in model industrialization , including MLflow, REST APIs, versioning, monitoring and MLOps .
Attention to explainability, reliability, security and AI governance topics.
3. Cloud & Modern Data Platforms
Practical knowledge of at least one major cloud provider ( preferably Azure , alternatively AWS or GCP).
Experience using native services for analytics, data engineering and AI ( Databricks, Fabric, Synapse, Azure ML, BigQuery, Snowflake ).
Ability to design scalable, high-performance and cost-efficient solutions on cloud-native platforms.
Nice to have
Knowledge of Git, GitHub/GitLab/Azure DevOps, version control and CI/CD pipelines , particularly with regard to version-controlled metadata, Data Contracts, configuration-as-code and automated controls .
Your Future With Us – What You’ll Find at KPMG
An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity ;
A stimulating and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork ;
Hybrid working arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance;
Advanced training and development programs to stay up to date;
An international mindset and innovative projects;
Initiatives focused on physical and mental well-being .
In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information regarding salaries received in current or previous employment relationships. Our recruitment procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.
Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary ranging from €38,000 to €51,000 . The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including the candidate’s skills and experience assessed against the requirements of the role.
Together for Better – Our Values and Our Commitment
Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity: these are the KPMG Values that create an environment open to the exchange of ideas and knowledge, enabling our professionals to reach their full potential .
Thanks to our commitment to fostering an inclusive working environment, our Network complies with the ISO 30415 standards for Diversity and Inclusion Management Systems and UNI/PdR 125 , relating to gender equality. Within our Impact Plan – Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) – you can find a summary of all the concrete actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance ( ESG ) issues.
Join us!

JD.COM / Joybuy::/job/ITA-Lombardy-Milan.title: service operations coordinator
JD.COM / Joybuy::/job/ITA-Lombardy-Milan.text:
Who We Are
At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.
Our Global Reach
JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
What We Offer
Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.
About The Team
You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Résumé du poste
Le/la Coordinateur(trice) des Opérations de Service joue un rôle clé dans le bon déroulement et l’efficacité des activités de service chez JD.com, Inc. . Ce poste consiste à coordonner les différentes opérations quotidiennes, à soutenir les équipes de service et à contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la satisfaction client et de la performance opérationnelle.
Responsabilités
Coordonner et suivre les opérations quotidiennes de service afin de garantir le respect des procédures internes et des engagements de niveau de service ( SLA ).
Être le point de contact central entre les équipes internes et les prestataires externes pour toutes les demandes et problématiques liées aux opérations de service.
Gérer et suivre les demandes de service, incidents et actions de résolution, et escalader les problématiques complexes vers les équipes compétentes lorsque nécessaire.
Participer à la mise en œuvre de nouveaux processus de service et aux projets d’amélioration opérationnelle.
Préparer et analyser les rapports opérationnels, identifier les tendances et proposer des solutions visant à améliorer la qualité de service et l’efficacité des opérations.
Contribuer à la planification des activités, à l’allocation des ressources et à la gestion des capacités des équipes de service.
Maintenir une documentation précise et à jour concernant les opérations, politiques, procédures et standards de service.
Collaborer avec les différents départements, notamment les équipes Logistique, Service Client et IT, afin d’optimiser les processus et les flux opérationnels.
Veiller au respect des politiques internes de l’entreprise ainsi que des exigences légales et réglementaires applicables aux activités de service.
Profil recherché
Diplôme de niveau Bac+3 ou supérieur en gestion, administration des entreprises, logistique, supply chain ou dans un domaine similaire.
1 à 3 ans d’expérience dans les opérations de service, la coordination opérationnelle ou un poste administratif similaire, idéalement dans un environnement e-commerce ou logistique.
Excellentes capacités d’organisation et de gestion du temps, avec la capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets et priorités simultanément.
Très bonnes compétences en communication écrite et orale ainsi qu’un bon relationnel.
Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Office , notamment Excel, Word et PowerPoint ; une expérience avec des outils opérationnels, ERP ou CRM constitue un avantage.
Solides capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche proactive dans l’identification et le traitement des difficultés opérationnelles.
Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant efficacement au sein d’une équipe, dans un environnement dynamique et exigeant.
Une bonne compréhension des opérations e-commerce et des principes de service client constitue un atout.
At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
Ready to apply?
Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.

JD.COM / Joybuy::/job/ITA-Lombardy-Milan.title: Transportation manager
JD.COM / Joybuy::/job/ITA-Lombardy-Milan.text:
Who We Are
At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.
Our Global Reach
JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
What We Offer
Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.
About The Team
You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Job Summary**
JD.com, Inc. is seeking a dynamic and experienced Transportation Manager to lead and optimize our logistics and transportation operations. This role is crucial for ensuring the efficient and timely movement of goods across our extensive network, supporting JD.com's commitment to exceptional customer service and operational excellence.
Job Responsibilities**
* Develop, implement, and manage transportation strategies and policies to optimize delivery speed, cost-efficiency, and service quality.
* Oversee daily transportation operations, including route planning, load optimization, carrier selection, and performance monitoring.
* Manage relationships with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, negotiate contracts, and ensure compliance with service level agreements.
* Monitor and analyze transportation metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to all relevant transportation regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
* Lead and mentor a team of transportation specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with warehouse operations, supply chain, and customer service teams to ensure seamless end-to-end logistics.
* Utilize data analytics and technology to drive decision-making and optimize transportation processes.
* Manage transportation budgets, control costs, and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Address and resolve transportation-related issues and escalations promptly and effectively.
Job Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in transportation management, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a large-scale e-commerce or retail environment.
* Proven track record of successfully managing complex transportation networks and optimizing logistics processes.
* Strong understanding of transportation regulations, freight modes (truckload, LTL, parcel, intermodal), and last-mile delivery challenges.
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and other logistics software.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop a team.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong negotiation and vendor management abilities.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across various departments.
* Proficiency in English; Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a significant plus.
At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Salesforce::/job/Italy---Milan/Data-360-.title: Data 360 - Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, Italian Speaking
Salesforce::/job/Italy---Milan/Data-360-.text:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Sales
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
About the Role
Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.
Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.
You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.
This is a hands-on data and software engineering role . You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.
What You'll Do
Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.
You're Our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer If...
You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation , including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing , and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases .
You diagnose technical problems methodically , use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
You can implement against a documented architecture , explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments .
You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities
Vuoi intraprendere una professione davvero significativa e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l'opportunità di aiutare clienti, azienda e colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse.
KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per supportarle nella trasformazione dei modelli di business, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e gestione dei rischi e nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.
Il team CRO/CRA services, all’interno del team Turnaround & Restructuring, assiste clienti profonda ristrutturazione aziendale e di rilancio industriale, offrendo supporto a tutti i livelli del management nelle fasi di alla stabilizzazione, strutturazione per la crescita e rilancio dell'azienda per l'avvio di un cambiamento sostenibile.
Nello specifico, il Transformation Manager è responsabile della progettazione, implementazione e gestione del Transformation Management Office (TMO) all’interno di programmi di ristrutturazione, turnaround e trasformazione aziendale complessi. Garantisce la disciplina esecutiva, il monitoraggio delle performance e l’allineamento tra piano industriale ed execution, operando spesso in contesti distressed o underperforming.
Entrando a far parte di un team riconosciuto per la qualità e la rilevanza dei progetti realizzati, avrai l'opportunità di lavorare con importanti clienti italiani e internazionali.
Ti occuperai di:
1 . Identificazione e setup governance del piano di trasformazione :
Disegno e implementazione della struttura TMO
Definizione della roadmap di trasformazione
2 . Execution del piano di trasformazione
Traduzione del piano industriale in iniziative operative
Supporto al management nell’accelerazione delle iniziative
Monitoraggio stato avanzamento
Identificazione e gestione criticità
3 . Performance tracking e value delivery
Monitoraggio KPI economico-finanziari (EBITDA, cash flow, working capital)
Validazione saving e revenue uplift
Preparazione di report per management e investitori
4. Stakeholder management
Interfaccia con stakeholders interni ed esterni alla società (Personale, Board Members, Creditori, Advisors, etc.
Supporto tavoli di crisi e negoziazioni
Preparazione materiali per board
5. Change management
Supporto all’adozione dei cambiamenti organizzativi
Comunicazione interna
Allineamento team operativi
Inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio, RAL indicativa compresa tra € 53.000 e €63.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi con riferimento specifico alle competenze e all’esperienza del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.
In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.

5-8 anni di esperienza in ambito restructuring e gestione delle crisi d'impresa / consulenza strategica / ruoli PMO-TPO ;
una laurea magistrale in discipline economiche con specializzazione in finanza o amministrazione, finanza e controllo (AFC), oppure in ingegneria gestionale con indirizzo finanziario;
un'ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese , preferibilmente accompagnata da esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all'estero;
un'ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office e Project&program management .

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities
Are you looking to pursue a truly meaningful and impactful career? At KPMG , you will have the opportunity to help clients, businesses, and colleagues address and solve today’s most pressing and complex challenges.
KPMG Advisory provides consulting services to support companies in transforming their business models, improving and digitizing processes, analyzing and managing risks, and executing strategic corporate finance transactions.
The Restructuring team supports clients through debt restructuring and business turnaround processes, providing financial advisory services and assistance in developing business plans aimed at stabilizing operations and enabling sustainable transformation.
Specifically, the Transformation Manager is responsible for the design, implementation, and management of the Transformation Management Office (TMO ) within complex restructuring, turnaround, and business transformation programs. The role ensures execution discipline, performance monitoring, and alignment between the business plan and its implementation, often operating in distressed or underperforming environments.
By joining a team recognized for the quality and significance of its projects, you will have the opportunity to work with leading Italian and international clients.
Key Responsibilities
1. Transformation Plan Governance Setup
Design and implementation of the TMO structure
Definition of the transformation roadmap
2. Transformation Plan Execution
Translate the business plan into operational initiatives
Support management in accelerating key initiatives
Monitor project progress and implementation status
Identify and manage critical issues and risks
3. Performance Tracking and Value Delivery
Monitor financial KPIs, including EBITDA, cash flow, and working capital
Validate cost savings and revenue enhancement initiatives
Prepare reports for management and investors
4. Stakeholder Management
Interface with internal and external stakeholders, including employees, board members, creditors, advisors, and other parties
Support crisis management committees and negotiation processes
Prepare materials and presentations for board meetings
5. Change Management
Support the adoption of organizational changes
Manage internal communications
Ensure alignment across operational teams
Employment will be governed by the Italian Commerce Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Commercio), with an indicative gross annual salary ranging from €53,000 to €63,000, determined on the basis of objective criteria, taking into account the candidate’s skills and experience relative to the position requirements.
In compliance with applicable regulations, we do not collect or use information regarding compensation earned in current or previous employment relationships. Furthermore, our recruitment procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.
Come As You Are – Your Skills and Characteristics
This opportunity is ideal for candidates who possess:
5 to 8 years of experience in restructuring , corporate crisis management , strategic consulting , or PMO/TPO roles ;
A Master’s degree in Economics , Finance, Accounting, Finance & Control (AFC), or Management Engineering with a focus on Finance;
Excellent command of the English language , preferably complemented by international study and/or work experience;
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and project/program management methodologies.

Hybrid working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programs to keep skills continuously updated.
An international environment with opportunities to work on innovative projects.
Initiatives dedicated to employees’ mental and physical well-being.
Together for Better – Our Values and Commitment
Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community, and integrity are the core values of KPMG . These principles help create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, enabling professionals to realize their full potential.
Thanks to its commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace , our Network complies with ISO 30415 standards for Diversity and Inclusion Management Systems and UNI/PdR 125 standards relating to gender equality.
Through its Impact Plan , KPMG outlines the concrete actions it has undertaken regarding Environmental, Social, and Governance ( ESG ) matters.

FTI Consulting::/job/Milan-Torre-Velasca.title: 2027 Graduate Associate, Corporate Finance
FTI Consulting::/job/Milan-Torre-Velasca.text:
Who We Are
FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
Are you ready to make your impact?
About The Role
In the Corporate Finance team at FTI Consulting, we focus on our clients’ strategic, operational, financial and capital needs by addressing the full spectrum of financial and transactional challenges faced by corporations, boards, private equity sponsors, creditor constituencies and other stakeholders. Our services include pre-deal commercial and operations due diligence, post-merger integration, business plan development, financial restructuring and insolvency solutions, and performance improvement, including interim management.
We work with major international financial institutions, private equity houses, global law firms, and corporates, on cases encompassing an extensive range of industries. We work closely with clients to quickly ascertain key issues and implement viable and sustainable restructuring solutions and exit strategies.
We are looking for those committed to delivering great work and striving for excellence in everything they do.
As part of our Corporate Finance team, you’ll have the opportunity to learn about our wide variety of fast-paced, international assignments. You’ll be part of our award-winning team of experts in a supportive and high-achieving environment.
FTI Consulting is looking to invest in your future by considering you for an Associate position, starting in September 2027.
What You’ll Do
Our Associates will gain an overview of all aspects of Corporate Finance at FTI Consulting. The successful candidate will participate in project teams, working with clients on the execution of various engagements.
Day-to-day tasks will vary by day, but you can expect to undertake many of the following:
Researching an identified sector or business to evaluate past trends, market sentiments, strategic, operational, commercial issues and opportunities and potential improvement areas.
Contribute to reports, pitches, stakeholder presentations and industry thought pieces.
Assist in conducting detailed market and company analysis to identify advisory opportunities.
Assist in performing financial and operational modelling to evaluate business viability, liquidity and profitability.
Assist in assessing operational efficiency through benchmarking and identify improvement opportunities.
Assist in the development of business plans, turnaround strategies and implementation roadmaps.
Contribute to carve-out and integration planning, supporting execution of restructuring initiatives.
Depending on capability and opportunity, being a part of a project and supporting team with analysis and deliverable creation.
How You’ll Grow
We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.
As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.
What You Will Need to Succeed
Basic Qualifications
Actively pursuing a full-time bachelor’s degree or completing a master’s program with a graduation date between June 2026 – June 2027
Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline will be considered, though quantitative degrees (e.g., Engineering, Economics, Finance, Business, etc.) are preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
Ability to think logically and work with numbers.
Inquiring mind and strong desire to learn and develop.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Good organization, self-management, proactivity, and teamwork skills.
Critical thinking skills and ability to think on your feet.
Computer literate with strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Fluent English and Italian speaker and writer.
Interest and passion for restructuring, business transformation and transactions.
The deadline for applications is: 29th October 2026
STEP 1: Complete our online application form and submit your CV (no cover letter required).
STEP 2: Attend up to three virtual case study interviews.
STEP 3: Job offers are made to successful candidates before Christmas.
#EMEAJT #LI-RR1
FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
Compensation
Minimum Pay: €42.000
Maximum Pay: €54.000
Compensation Disclosure: The candidate will be assigned to the category of the white-collars (impiegati) and with application of the National Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Employees of the Commercial Sector (Confcommercio), with all relevant economic provisions.
Compensation range reflects potential gross base salary for the posted role. The actual salary is determined with reference to the relevant market sector, taking into account the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications.

Our Deal Strategy team provides support in M&As , from the pre-deal evaluation to the post-deal integration or separation with focus on the definition and quantification of all value creation levers. As a member of this team, you will work in close contact with lenders, shareholders and managers at all levels, helping to support clients in corporate finance transactions using digital tools and technology in your day-to-day work.
Join our teams in Rome where you will gain experience supporting shareholders and management of client companies in solving complex business challenges, from the definition of strategy to the execution of value creation initiatives, with focus on the Pre-Deal Business/Operational Due Diligence, Business Planning and Post-Deal Integration phases.
Specifically, you will be tasked with:
Business & Strategic Planning: You’ll work alongside C-level executives to assess the business in a short time framework and define/ quantify improvement actions to present to investors and stakeholders;
Business & Commercial Due Diligence: You’ll analyze business dynamics, market, and competition for potential targets, working with private equity funds and other buyers;
Identification and review of synergies both in a pre and post deal phase. Support in the implementation of tracking models of the synergies identified in the "execution" phase;
Synergy assessment and execution: You will analyze all potential synergies both in a pre and post deal phase, supporting end to end the client from the quantification phase to the implementation/ tracking of the identified synergies;
Integration & Separation Management Office: You will define and drive Day 1 Readiness plan, D100 Integration plan, definition of Target Operating Model, etc.

Senior Consultant - ServiceNow
4 set 2026
The chance to build a better future is right in front of you
Do Work That Matters - Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità
Vuoi fare un lavoro che abbia un impatto concreto sulle organizzazioni? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di affiancare aziende di diversi settori nei loro percorsi di trasformazione digitale, contribuendo alla progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni che migliorano il funzionamento dei processi aziendali.
KPMG Advisory supporta le imprese nell’evoluzione dei propri modelli operativi attraverso l’ottimizzazione dei processi, l’adozione di piattaforme digitali e l’introduzione di soluzioni tecnologiche in grado di rendere le attività più efficienti, integrate e tracciabili.
Entrando a far parte dell'area Enterprise Platform nel team ServiceNow , contribuirai alla progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni basate sulla piattaforma ServiceNow, utilizzata dalle organizzazioni per gestire e digitalizzare processi operativi e di servizio, come IT Service Management, gestione delle richieste interne e workflow tra diverse funzioni aziendali.
Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:
Analizzare i processi e i requisiti di business del cliente, collaborando con stakeholder di diverse funzioni aziendali per identificare opportunità di digitalizzazione e miglioramento dei flussi operativi .
Supportare la progettazione della soluzione applicativa su piattaforma ServiceNow, contribuendo alla definizione del design funzionale e alla configurazione dei moduli più adatti alle esigenze del cliente.
Configurare e personalizzare i moduli ServiceNow (in particolare ambiti ITSM, ITOM e/o CSM), traducendo i requisiti di business in workflow e funzionalità implementate sulla piattaforma.
Contribuire alla definizione e alla produzione della documentazione progettuale (analisi funzionali, specifiche di configurazione, documentazione di processo).
Partecipare alle attività di testing della soluzione (SIT e UAT), collaborando con gli utenti del cliente per verificare la corretta implementazione dei requisiti e garantire la qualità delle soluzioni rilasciate.
Supportare le fasi di rilascio e go-live della soluzione, affiancando il cliente durante il periodo di hypercare e contribuendo alla risoluzione delle eventuali criticità operative .
Nel corso delle attività potrai essere coinvolta/o in progetti nazionali e internazionali , lavorando con team multidisciplinari e clienti appartenenti a diversi settori industriali.
Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche
Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:
Hai maturato esperienza su progetti di implementazione ServiceNow , idealmente su moduli come ITSM, ITOM o CSM .
Hai esperienza nella raccolta e analisi dei requisiti funzionali e nella configurazione di soluzioni applicative su piattaforma ServiceNow.
Hai familiarità con la progettazione e gestione di workflow digitali e processi di service management .
Hai partecipato a progetti di implementazione o evoluzione di piattaforme enterprise in contesti consulenziali o IT.
Possiedi una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, necessaria per lavorare in contesti progettuali internazionali.
Sei disponibile a trasferte nazionali e internazionali, in linea con le esigenze dei progetti.
Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG
Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità
Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra
Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale
Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati
Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative
Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico
Inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio, RAL indicativa compresa tra € 31.000 e € 41.000 per la qualifica di Senior Consultant e tra € 38.000 e € 51.000 per la qualifica di Assistant Manager, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi con riferimento specifico alle competenze e all’esperienza del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.
In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.
Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno
Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale .
Grazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415 , sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125 , relativa alla parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni concrete che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance ( ESG ).
Unisciti a noi!
I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.
KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità.
The chance to build a better future is right in front of you
Do Work That Matters - Your Role and Responsibilities
Do you want to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and colleagues tackle and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory provides consulting services to businesses, assisting them in transforming their business models, improving and digitizing processes, analyzing and managing risks, and supporting extraordinary financial operations.
By joining the Enterprise Platform Team , you will be involved in managing organizational change processes. Together with experienced colleagues, you will analyze strategic requirements to implement the best digital solutions available on the market for integrated process management.
Specifically, your responsibilities will include:
Analyzing business requirements, collaborating with various corporate areas to identify needs in ITSM, ITOM, and other ServiceNow applications.
Designing optimal solutions using the ServiceNow platform, configuring and customizing it to meet the specific needs of the client.
Drafting detailed documentation, including functional and technical analyses, for end-to-end processes related to business and IT workflows.
Configuring ServiceNow modules, ensuring that the solution is tailored to the client’s needs and objectives.
Conducting internal tests and collaborating with end users to ensure that the solutions meet KPMG’s and the client’s quality standards.
Delivering training sessions for business users, supporting them in correctly adopting the implemented solutions.
Providing support to clients during the go-live phase and Hypercare period, ensuring a smooth transition and consolidation of new functionalities.
You will work on both national and international projects, collaborating with highly qualified professionals and working closely with clients from various industries, delivering tailored solutions to meet their specific business needs.
Come As You Are - Your Skills and Characteristics
This opportunity is perfect for you if:
You have experience implementing ServiceNow solutions , with a specific focus on modules such as ITSM, ITOM, and/or CSM.
You have solid experience in managing complex business processes , focusing on their optimization and digitization through workflow automation.
You have a good command of the English language , preferably with study and/or work experiences abroad.
You are available to travel nationally and internationally to support clients at all project stages.
Your Future With Us - What You’ll Find at KPMG
An inclusive, fair work environment that respects, encourages, and values diversity.
A stimulating and dynamic setting that fosters creativity and teamwork.
A hybrid working model to promote a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programs to keep your skills up-to-date.
An international mindset and innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on physical and mental well-being.
Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a gross annual salary ranging from €31,000 to €41,000 for the Senior Consultant position and from €38,000 to €51,000 for the Assistant Manager position. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including the candidate's skills and experience assessed against the requirements of the role.
In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.
Together for Better - Our Values and Commitment
Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community, and integrity: these are the values of KPMG that create an environment open to the exchange of ideas and knowledge, allowing our professionals to fully express their potential.
As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125 , relating to gender equality.
Our Impact Plan outlines the concrete actions we are taking on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) topics. Learn more here: Our Impact Plan .
Join us!
Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) No. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") and subsequent amendments. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy.

Salesforce::/job/Italy---Rome/Principal-.title: Principal Technical Deployment Strategist, Italian Speaking - Agentforce/ AI Space
Salesforce::/job/Italy---Rome/Principal-.text:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Sales
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value. Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
Key Responsibilities
Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.
Required Qualifications
4+ years (6-10 years for Senior levels) experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
Ability to travel to customer sites as needed to ensure client success
Business level proficiency in Italian and English
Computer Science or Related Degree
Preferred Experience
Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
Accommodations
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
Posting Statement
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.
The typical base salary range for this position is EUR 88,200 to EUR 117,900 annually. Italy CBA (Contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro del commercio) (01/04/2015 - ) Quadri
In addition to the base salary, this position may offer access to a range of additional benefits including an incentive component which is tailored by grade level.

ServiceNow::744000151091297.title: Sr Director, EMEA South COO
ServiceNow::744000151091297.text:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
This executive role is being newly created to support the continued growth and transformation of our EMEA South business. Reporting into the EMEA COO organization, the EMEA South COO will serve as the primary deputy to the SVP of EMEA South — present in the field, engaged with customers, and accountable for business outcomes across a diverse, multicultural region (France, Italy, Spain, Israel, UAE, Saudi Arabia, South Africa).
The role sits at the heart of the EMEA South leadership team, working in close partnership with Core Sales, Solution Consulting, Solution Sales, Marketing, Customer Excellence Group, GPC, other key GTM functions and more importantly with the Chief of Staff and the Strategic Pursuit Lead. Where the Chief of Staff ensures the operational engine of the region runs effectively and GTM programs land with discipline, and the Strategic Pursuit Lead coordinates the region’s most complex deals, the COO’s focus is squarely on customer impact, field leadership, and revenue performance.
The right person gets their energy from winning — from building relationships at the C-suite, from helping teams close transformational deals, and from raising the bar on what the region can achieve.
In this role you will
Act as deputy to the SVP of EMEA South, representing the regional leadership in customer meetings, executive briefings, internal reviews, and strategic external engagements
Drive business performance across EMEA South, holding the organization accountable for targets and outcomes alongside the SVP
Overlook South Strategic planning, demand generation plan, pipeline excellence and customer adoption by coordinating and giving direction to the extended South leadership team.
Represent EMEA COO office in South region by ensuring execution of Pan EMEA initiatives and decisions.
Build and sustain senior relationships with customer executives across the region, reinforcing ServiceNow’s value at the highest levels of key accounts
Engage on strategic pursuits at the executive level, providing senior sponsorship and customer presence while partnering with the Strategic Pursuit Lead on deal structure and process
Champion talent development across the region, identifying and growing the next generation of leaders in partnership with country managers
Represent EMEA South in EMEA-wide and global leadership forums, actively sharing and seeking best practice across Major Areas and GEOs
To be successful in this role you have:
Proven track record in enterprise software sales or sales leadership, with demonstrated success in complex, multi-stakeholder deals and GTM coordination & execution
Strong customer-facing experience at C-suite level, with the presence and credibility to represent ServiceNow at the highest levels
Comfortable acting as a senior delegate and decision-maker in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Strong people leadership, motivated by developing others and building high-performing teams
Highly collaborative, able to work across a broad set of stakeholders — including the Chief of Staff and pursuit functions — with clarity and without duplication
Experienced in multicultural, multi-country organisations; EMEA South exposure a strong advantage
Energetic, resilient, with a growth mindset and a drive to win in a competitive market
An effective communicator, credible at executive level both verbally and in writing
Role can be based in Paris or Rome.
The role of Sr Director, EMEA South COO is subject to the National Collective Bargaining Agreement of Trade Sector (CCNL) and will be classified as DIRIGENTE. For such role we offer an initial gross base pay of EUR [from 118700 to 219600]. This role will also be eligible for the Company's corporate bonus, MBO, or commission incentive leading to a target gross annual OTE of EUR [from 154,310 to 285,480] and whose specific amount depends on the company and individual performance and is determined in accordance with company's plans from time to time in force and which the company may change in the course of the employment and of which you will be informed in advance. Please note that the final compensation will be determined during the offer process based on the candidate's experience, skills, competence, qualifications and work location in relation to the offered position, as well as relevant indications from the CCNL, applying objective and gender-neutral criteria. ServiceNow also provides a competitive benefits package that supports employees' health, financial wellbeing, family life, and work-life balance. Benefits include generous paid leave, meal vouchers, employee share purchase opportunities, comprehensive insurance coverage, and access to wellbeing, mental health, and family-forming support programs.
As mentioned, compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location. We will share all the relevant details for this role at the relevant recruitment stage.
Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
Accommodations
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
Export Control Regulations
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
