Senior - Digital and Computer Forensic
L'opportunità di costruire un futuro migliore è proprio davanti a te
Do Work That Matters – Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità
Desideri svolgere un lavoro davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l'opportunità di aiutare clienti, società e colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per supportarle nella trasformazione del modello di business, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.
Nello specifico, entrando a far parte del Forensic Technology Team di Milano, aiuterai le aziende a prevenire, individuare e minimizzare i rischi economici, reputazionali e informatici derivanti da frodi, irregolarità, controversie commerciali e finanziarie e violazioni contrattuali. Acquisirai un vantaggio competitivo e contribuirai a offrire soluzioni integrate e approcci innovativi per la gestione strategica del rischio.
Responsabilità
Guidare progetti complessi di e-discovery e indagini di digital forensics, inclusa la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la revisione qualitativa delle attività;
Utilizzare tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia e le più rigorose metodologie forensi per analizzare dati e sviluppare soluzioni innovative;
Gestire la raccolta, la conservazione e l'analisi delle prove digitali, garantendo la conformità agli standard forensi e ai requisiti normativi;
Promuovere l'utilizzo di analisi avanzate e tecnologie innovative per estrarre informazioni significative e supportare le strategie investigative;
Garantire l'eccellenza nell'erogazione dei servizi, il rispetto delle tempistiche e la qualità dei risultati su più incarichi contemporaneamente;
Collaborare con un team di professionisti altamente qualificati;

On Prime Video, customers can customize their viewing experience and find their favourite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies Fallout, Heads of State, Reacher, Red One, Road House, The Accountant 2, The Boys, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, and The Summer I Turned Pretty; UK produced Originals such as The Girlfriend, Steal, Clarkson’s Farm, Molly-Mae: Behind it All, My Fault: London and Last One Laughing UK; licensed fan favorites such as Nine Perfect Strangers S2 and The Assassin; Prime member exclusive access to coverage of live sports including UEFA Champions League and NBA, and acclaimed sports documentaries including, Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues, Sven and the Amazon Original All or Nothing franchise, including All or Nothing: Arsenal. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on
This is a uniquely dual-natured role that sits at the intersection of operational excellence and strategic vision. As Creator Operations & Strategy Manager, you will be a driving force behind how Prime Video delivers the Creator Marketing strategy — owning the end-to-end operational backbone and agency management, while simultaneously helping to shape the direction of Creators for Prime Video. You'll roll up your sleeves to solve tactical challenges when needed, and step back to develop strategies that elevate our creator presence at scale. If you thrive in environments where no two days look the same, and you're equally comfortable in the detail of execution as well as discussing strategy this role could be for you.
Key job responsibilities
Manage the creator tooling ecosystem with key internal partners — including creator campaign management, measurement and analytics solutions.
Develop accurate cost estimates and manage budgets to ensure projects are completed within the allocated resources. Involves analyzing historical data, identifying potential cost drivers, and implementing cost control measures.
Dual ownership in creator agency management and ongoing ways of working and mechanisms.
Establish new creator marketing programmes that scale across all locales.
Review and develop processes for Creator marketing, including implementation of AI solutions, working alongside multiple partner teams.
Drive key strategic projects, including strategic direction, implementation plans, stakeholder alignment and adoption.
Owns capacity planning through analysing team resource utilization and forecast future capacity needs to accommodate growth and changes in demand.
Track, analyse and report results and own standardisation of reporting across the region.
Unblock issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make recommendations for trade-offs, and meet delivery timelines.
About the team
Amazon MGM Studios is the home for talent, creating and producing Original films and television series for a global audience. Original series premiere exclusively on Prime Video, which is available in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Amazon MGM Studios also produces and acquires Original movies for theatrical release and exclusively for Prime Video
Basic Qualifications
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
Experience in marketing or marketing research
Experience in the entertainment industry
Experience in working directly with creators and developing creator careers in a talent management, agency or platform role
Experience in Creator marketing across multiple locales
Preferred Qualifications
Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs
Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation

Apply now
Description
12 month Fixed Term Contract (Maternity Cover)
This is a senior, high-visibility role owning our most sophisticated brand partnerships end-to-end. You will lead Tier 1 custom executions — the bespoke, IP-led integrations that represent the pinnacle of what we offer advertisers — taking them from concept through creative development, cross-functional alignment and delivery. You will also run our custom-integration think tank: the engine that invents, pressure-tests and scales new partnership formats. You will be the connective tissue between commercial ambition and creative execution, and a trusted senior partner to teams across PVI Marketing, Amazon Ads, Studios and Brand Innovation Lab.
Key job responsibilities
Tier 1 custom executions
Own Tier 1 brand partnerships and custom executions end-to-end — from opportunity framing and creative concept through development, production alignment and delivery.
Lead bespoke, IP-led integrations across EU titles (e.g. custom ad production, co-branded content, product placement and licensing tie-ins), ensuring each is on-brief, on-brand and delivered to a high creative standard.
Act as the senior day-to-day owner for flagship partnerships, coordinating advertisers, agencies, production partners and internal teams to keep complex, multi-workstream deals on track.
Manage approvals and creative sign-off for custom assets (e.g. tagged tune-ins, end cards, taglines), securing the right internal and legal clearances.
Custom-integration think tank
Run the custom-integration think tank — identifying, developing and pressure-testing new partnership formats that extend our offering beyond standard sponsorship.
Champion innovation and creative ambition while balancing commercial viability, operational feasibility and customer experience.
Bring market and competitive insight to shape the forward roadmap of custom formats for future slates.
Cross-functional leadership
Partner senior stakeholders across PVI Marketing, Amazon Ads (VSS, Go-to-Market, BIL) and Amazon MGM Studios to align on title selection, creative direction and ways of working.
Lead co-creation models across PVA, BIL and PVI Marketing, defining a shared north-star vision per partnership and clear ownership through development and production.
Author operating-model and process documentation, and drive cross-functional forums (title alignment meetings, programme reviews) that keep partners aligned.
Influence without authority across a complex, matrixed organisation, resolving trade-offs between creative, commercial and operational priorities.
Commercial & operating model
Structure commercially viable custom opportunities and packages, working with Finance, Business Affairs and Legal on terms, compliance and contracting.
Track performance and advertiser voice-of-customer, using insight to improve conversion, deal size and repeatability.
About the team
Prime Video Advertising’s Brand Partnerships team turns Prime Video’s world-class IP into premium, custom partnerships for the world’s biggest advertisers. Across EU and LATCANZ, we go beyond standard sponsorship to build bespoke, high-craft integrations — connecting brands to our titles through custom creative, product placement, licensing and multi-market campaigns. We work at the intersection of PVI Marketing, Amazon Ads, Amazon MGM Studios and the Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) to deliver partnerships that are commercially significant and creatively excellent, while protecting the customer experience and the integrity of our content.
Basic Qualifications
Experience in developing, negotiating and executing business agreements
Experience in a professional field or military
Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking
Experience working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services
Experience solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Global Financial Services Industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries
Experience solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries
Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT.
Experience working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations
Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
Preferred Qualifications
Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

Contentsquare::13eb7985-1ab2-4ef6-990a-c.title: People Operations & Solutions Lead
Contentsquare::13eb7985-1ab2-4ef6-990a-c.text:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.
Shape how our People function operates at scale.
We’re looking for a Global People Operations & Workday Governance Lead to sit at the intersection of People, Technology, Data and Transformation.
You’ll play a key role in building a scalable, secure and data-driven People function — owning global governance, driving Workday strategy, leading cross-functional cycles and helping us unlock the potential of automation and AI.
What you’ll do
🌍 Global People Governance
Own and drive alignment across global People processes, working closely with People Business Process Owners and senior People leadership.
Act as a key escalation point for complex Workday, People Operations and People Data matters.
Partner with Audit, Legal and Compliance to ensure strong controls, segregation of duties and secure access to People data.
⚙️ Workday, Automation & Transformation
Act as a strategic Business Process Owner and key partner to our Workday Product Owner and ISD.
Translate People needs into technical requirements and help shape the Workday roadmap and backlog.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve People processes, including through AI and emerging technologies.
Partner with Transformation to turn these opportunities into scalable solutions.
🧬 People Data & Analytics
Own global governance and integrity of People data, ensuring it is clean, consistent, secure and ready for advanced analytics and AI.
Partner with the business to develop dashboards, reporting and data solutions that enable better decision-making.
Oversee data access requests and ensure sensitive People data is appropriately protected.
🔄 Cross-functional Delivery
Lead major People cycles such as performance and compensation reviews, coordinating delivery across multiple People functions.
Drive change management, communication, documentation and training to ensure successful adoption of new Workday processes.
What we’re looking for
You’ll combine strategic thinking with strong operational and Workday expertise. You’ll ideally bring:
Experience in People Operations, HRIS, Workday, People Technology or a related field.
Strong understanding of global People processes, data and governance.
Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects and stakeholders.
The ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.
A strong interest in automation, AI and the future of People Technology.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and at senior level.
Why this role?
This isn’t just about keeping People processes running. It’s about designing how they should work in the future.
You’ll have the opportunity to shape our global People operating model, influence our Workday roadmap, strengthen our data foundations and help build a smarter, more automated People function.

Contentsquare::7a36cb77-bcab-4c1d-89d0-1.title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
Contentsquare::7a36cb77-bcab-4c1d-89d0-1.text:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.
About the job
The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.
You will work across two types of engagements:
One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)
Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.
You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..
This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.
If you are not located in the offer’s specified location, the role is open to fully remote work within the country mentioned in the job posting.
What you’ll do
Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.
Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.
Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.
Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.
Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.
Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.
Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.
Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.
Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise
Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.
Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.
Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.
Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.
Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.
You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.
Partner with customers and internal teams
Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.
Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.
Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.
Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.
Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.
Identify risks and opportunities
Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.
Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.
Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.
Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.
Improve how we work
Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.
Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.
Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.
Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.
What you’ll need to succeed
Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.
Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.
Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.
Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.
Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.
Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.
Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.
Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.
Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.
Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.
Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.
Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.
Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.
Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.
Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.
Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Four or more years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Pricing, or financial analysis.
Experience supporting complex enterprise B2B SaaS transactions.
Strong analytical, organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Salesforce and Excel or Google Sheets.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
A collaborative, commercially minded approach with the confidence to advise and influence stakeholders.

Amazon::10531651.text:
Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of digital advertising and eCommerce, and offers advertisers a rich array of media solutions across Amazon’s mobile and desktop websites, proprietary devices including Kindle and Fire TV, and the Amazon Programmatic Demand Side Platform (DSP). We are looking for a highly motivated Campaign and Creative Manager (CCM) who is passionate about helping our advertisers make effective, analytically driven marketing decisions. Change the world as our advertiser’s “go-to” experts on Amazon Advertising’s policy, process, creative services and retail business.
Live Events at Amazon is the advertising business built around premium live sports and live events streamed on Prime Video. Rather than traditional on-demand placements, it delivers ads into live broadcasts - matches, games, episodes and tournaments - letting advertisers reach large, engaged, appointment-viewing crowds in the way linear TV historically has, but with digital targeting, interactivity, and measurement layered on top.
What will you be able to achieve in this team?
Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions
Develop never-been-done-before executions with advertisers and internal partners during the pre-sales stage
Establish and standardize creative and operational best practices with advertisers to drive creative performance and provide frustration-free campaign launches
Grow and broaden your skills as you work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation
Key job responsibilities
Manage the planning and delivery of high quality advertiser engagements to educate advertisers on Amazon policies and creative best practices to positively impact campaign performance within the Live Events space
Project managing the execution of complex Live Event advertising campaigns with internal Design, AdOps, Sales, Quality Assurance and Account Management teams as well as external stakeholders
Manage the Ad Schedule creation for live events, closely working with production on break durations and content
Consulting with advertisers on creative strategy using historical advertiser and industry data
Manage the troubleshooting of sometimes complex issues surfaced during the campaign life-cycle
Dive deep on data to develop and manage process and product improvement projects with internal and external stakeholders to improve cross-vertical/cross-locale efficiency
A day in the life
You will earn trust and foster frustration-free advertiser experiences through seamless end to end management of campaigns, data-driven creative strategy recommendations and ongoing advertiser education, all aimed at helping advertisers grow their business on Amazon while upholding our end customers’ experience. You will work with our partners to deliver results that matter to our advertisers for long-term growth. CCMs provide efficient and accurate campaign management while identifying opportunities to continuously improve workflows and implement best practices. The role provides a fast-paced environment that offers team members continual opportunities to learn, be curious and develop their skills.
About the team
If you love sports, solving big-customer problems and have a passion for new technology in the media space, then this role is an amazing opportunity that lies at the intersection of your interests. With broadcast agreements around the world including the NFL’s Thursday Night Football in the US, NBA globally, UAEFA Champions League in the UK, Wimbledon in Germany and The French Open (Roland-Garros) in France, Amazon Prime Video is delivering the future of Live Sports for our Prime customers. Advertising is a crucial part of our success in Live Sports and at Amazon Advertising, we sit at the intersection of advertising and eCommerce. We are building a world-class live sports ad program that benefits our customers, advertisers and league partners with unique, never-been-done-before ad experiences.

This position can be based from any EMEA Corporate Location or current site (pending site lead, PXT and Hiring manager approval).
As an Incident Response Manager within Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Security Operations Group (SOG), you will serve as the primary crisis response coordinator for high and moderate severity incidents (SEV1, SEV2 and SEV3) impacting Amazon's people, operations, assets, and brand across globally. You will independently own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical incidents from initial notification and triage though immediate mitigation, stakeholder coordination, and post-incident review. Reporting to the Sr. Manager – Operations Incident Management, you will operate within established GSOC and SOG protocols, lead Incident Management Teams (IMTs) through complex crisis events, and drive continuous improvement of response frameworks across one of Amazon's most dynamic operating environments.
Key job responsibilities
Lead end-to-end coordination of high severity incidents (SEV1/SEV2), managing the full lifecycle from initial notification through mitigation, stabilization, and closure
Own 24/7/365 on-call rotation, responding to threats and incidents within the CTI Matrix per SOG escalation procedures, including Slack channel activation and senior leadership notification
Coordinate Immediate Mitigation calls with site-level Incident Commanders and IMTs, assigning action items to ensure life safety, operational continuity, and brand protection
Execute tactical response protocols including video lockdown, ESU/Off-Duty deployments, and OSINT/SOCMINT analysis within established timelines
Prepare site risk overviews and deliver incident summaries to WWOS senior leadership within 4 hours of incident onset
Manage Incident Room operations including real-time updates, dynamic action tracking, EMT notifications, and stakeholder conference calls
Lead After Action Reviews within 3 days of incident conclusion, driving corrective actions and mechanism implementation to prevent recurrence
Maintain and validate high severity protocols, the CTI Matrix, escalation workflows, and response timelines through continuous improvement
Partner with GSOC, Regional S&LP, Operations, WHS, and PXT to influence decision-making and ensure site-level IMT readiness per WWOS Critical Incident Response standards
A day in the life
As an Incident Response Manager, your day begins by reviewing active Incident Rooms, monitoring the GSOC threat landscape, and independently assessing emerging threats against the Category, Type, and Item (CTI) matrix to determine escalation requirements. You drive strategic and tactical work simultaneously, supporting Immediate Mitigation (IM) calls with site-level Incident Commanders and IMTs, and leading real-time response actions. Throughout the week, you engage senior stakeholders across WWOS, Ops, PXT, ER, WHS, and Ops Disruption leadership, supporting GSOC Conference Calls and guiding decision-making during critical incidents. You own On-Call rotation responsibilities, responding to emerging threats with direct mitigation support including coordinating ESU/Off-Duty deployments, conducting OSINT/SOCMINT analysis, and delivering initial incident summaries to WWOS senior leadership within established SLAs. When high severity events arise, you exercise independent judgment to create site-specific Slack channels, manage video lockdown tickets, prepare site risk overviews and hardening posture assessments, and lead After Action Reviews (AARs) within 3 days of incident conclusion.
About the team
The Operational Incident Response (OIR) team sits within the Security Operations Group (SOG) under Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS). The team provides 24/7/365 critical incident coordination across WWAS operations, serving as the central point for real-time response to life safety events, operational disruptions, natural disasters, workplace violence, and facility security threats. Working through the GSOC, the team brings together key stakeholders, manages Incident Rooms, and drives resolution from first notification through post-incident review.
OIR members are senior individual contributors who independently own the full incident lifecycle. They coordinate Immediate Mitigation calls with site-level Incident Commanders and IMTs, facilitate GSOC Conference Calls for SEV1 events, and deliver incident summaries to WWOS senior leadership. Key partnerships include GSOC, Regional S&LP, Operations leadership, Legal, and cross-functional business continuity stakeholders across highly diversified global environments.
The team operates as a service to the business, ensuring continuation of operations through risk oversight, contingency planning, and structured response. This role requires independent judgment under pressure, real-time coordination across multiple time zones, and the ability to influence senior leadership during unfolding events where life safety is at stake.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Risk Management, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field
Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience with end-to-end project management
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
Experience in a high-volume environment, such as a security operations center, event security, call center, or crisis management/emergency response center
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
Master's degree in risk management, Security, Business Administration, or related field
A security/risk management industry certification (ASIS CPP, CRMP, CBCP, or equivalent)
Advanced experience with risk, business continuity, and data management platforms (BSI, Audit Board, etc.)
Direct user experience with geo-spatial tools and platforms (ArcGIS, ESRI, Palantir, etc.)

Description
AWS is seeking a Senior Customer Success Specialist - AI Driven Digital Product Delivery to lead strategic transformation initiatives for organizations adopting Amazon Kiro and AWS's generative AI platform to revolutionize how they build and deliver digital products. This is a senior individual contributor role within the AWS Specialists & Partners (ASP) Customer Success Center of Excellence, requiring a combination of executive-level strategic vision and practical credibility to help customers fundamentally reimagine their software development lifecycle using AI.
Amazon Kiro is AWS's AI-powered platform that transforms how organizations build software, from requirements gathering and architecture design to code generation, testing, and deployment. This role focuses on helping customers move beyond AI-assisted coding to systematic AI-driven digital product delivery transformation at enterprise scale.
You will define the methodologies, frameworks, and repeatable models that shape how AWS and its customers approach AI-driven digital product delivery transformation. Your work will directly influence product roadmaps, partner ecosystems, and go-to-market strategies, creating lasting organizational and market impact across hundreds of organizations globally.
Key job responsibilities
Strategic Customer Transformation
Design and lead comprehensive AI-driven digital product delivery transformation strategies for enterprise customers adopting Amazon Kiro and AWS Gen AI services, addressing SDLC modernization, engineering culture evolution, organizational capabilities, change management, and value realization through integrated frameworks and executive alignment.
Offering Development & Scaling
Build repeatable transformation methodologies, maturity models, and assessment frameworks that enable AWS and partners to guide customers from AI-assisted development to systematic agentic SDLC transformation at scale.
Synthesize learnings from customer engagements into documented playbooks, best practices, and success patterns that inform AWS product roadmap and GTM strategy.
Partner Ecosystem Enablement
Co-develop transformation offerings with strategic consulting partners (GSIs, SIs, boutique AI/DevOps consultancies) and support partner-led enablement programs, including training, certification, and delivery toolkits, that scale high-quality customer success delivery through the partner ecosystem.
Customer Success Management
Monitor customer transformation health and proactively address adoption barriers while driving measurable business value realization (development velocity, quality improvement, time-to-market reduction, developer productivity) through structured success planning and executive business reviews.
Thought Leadership & Innovation

Influence Amazon Kiro product roadmap through synthesized customer insights and represent AWS as a recognized expert at industry forums and executive events.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

7+ years of experience in senior customer-facing roles including customer success management, strategic consulting, or digital transformation advisory, with direct accountability for enterprise customer outcomes
10+ years leading complex, large-scale software development transformation or engineering modernization programs with significant technology enablement components in enterprise contexts
Proven track record developing and scaling customer success programs or transformation methodologies, including creating original frameworks adopted broadly by large teams or partner organizations
Deep expertise in enterprise software development lifecycle transformation and engineering practices modernization, with direct experience advising organizations through significant SDLC reinvention initiatives (not just tool implementations)
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise change management initiatives involving AI/automation adoption in software development contexts, including engineering culture transformation and adoption measurement
Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence C-suite and VP-level stakeholders on engineering strategy and digital product delivery transformation (not just technology decisions)
Preferred Qualifications
PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
L300+ understanding of Amazon Kiro capabilities (AI-powered code generation, testing, documentation, architecture assistance) and the AWS Gen AI platform (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, foundational models, agentic frameworks) with ability to articulate technical capabilities in business value terms to executive audiences
5+ years of direct experience in software development transformation, DevOps/platform engineering, or enterprise SDLC modernization initiatives at scale, with measurable outcomes achieved
Deep understanding of AI/ML capabilities for software development including code generation, automated testing, documentation generation, architecture assistance, and agentic development workflows
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex customer insights into actionable strategic frameworks with broad applicability across industries
Hands-on experience with Amazon Kiro, AWS AI/ML services (Bedrock, SageMaker), or comparable AI-powered development platforms in customer-facing delivery contexts
Understanding of modern software development practices (CI/CD, DevSecOps, platform engineering), cloud-native architectures, and integration patterns required for AI-driven development workflows
Experience designing large-scale organizational change management programs for engineering organizations including communication, training, and adoption
Experience building partner ecosystems and enablement programs, including co-developing transformation methodologies with strategic consulting partners
Published thought leadership in software development transformation, AI-powered development, or engineering productivity, with track record influencing product roadmaps through customer insight synthesis

At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Construction Manager to drive health and safety across our construction projects. In this role you ensure our construction sites and vendors meet Amazon's safety standards and local regulations, partnering with contractors and project teams to embed safe working from design through delivery. You'll be the safety point of contact for construction activity in your area, keeping the people who build our sites safe.

Conduct construction site safety inspections and review vendor safety documentation.
Partner with project teams and contractors to embed safe working from design through delivery.
Track construction safety performance and drive closure of identified gaps.

Impiegato amministrativo contabile - Company Members Administration
We don’t imagine a better future. We’re building it
Do Work That Matters - Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità
Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse.
KPMG Business Services offre servizi interni all’organizzazione, supportando tutte le linee di servizio e coadiuvando i professionisti nella gestione delle attività quotidiane. In particolare, entrando a far parte del Team Finance Administration come impiegato Amministrativo contabile (Company Members Administration) di Milano, sarai responsabile di fornire i più alti standard di assistenza diretta e di supporto alla Leadership e ai componenti del Management Group.
Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:
Assistenza nella dichiarazione dei redditi (Mod. Unico Persone Fisiche);
Tenuta della regolare contabilità;
Liquidazioni IVA;
Gestione adempimenti infra-annuali.
Come As you Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche
Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:
Hai una laurea triennale o magistrale in ambito economico;
Hai buona conoscenza della fiscalità delle Persone Fisiche titolari di Partita IVA;
Hai ottima capacità di utilizzo dei principali applicativi di Microsoft Office (in particolare funzioni avanzate di Excel);
Hai ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative;
Sei predisposto al teamwork e al problem solving;
Hai capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli.
Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG
Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità;
Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra;
Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale;
Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati;
Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative;
Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico.
Inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio al IV° livello; la retribuzione sarà definita e commisurata in relazione a criteri oggettivi quali competenze, esperienza effettiva maturata e aderenza ai requisiti richiesti per la posizione.
In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.
Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno
Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale .
Grazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , il nostro Network ha ottenuto le certificazioni ISO 30415 , che attesta la conformità del Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125 , che certifica la parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - bit.ly/OurImpactPlanKPMG - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni concrete che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance ( ESG ).
Unisciti a noi!
I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.

We don’t imagine a better future. We’re building it.
Do Work That Matters – Your Role and Responsibilities
Do you want to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and your colleagues address and solve today’s most important and complex challenges.
KPMG Business Services provides internal services to the organization, supporting all service lines and assisting professionals in managing their day-to-day activities. As part of the Finance Administration Team as an Accounting and Administrative Specialist ( Company Members Administration) based in Milan , you will be responsible for providing the highest standards of direct assistance and support to the Leadership team and members of the Management Group.
Specifically, you will be responsible for:
Assisting with personal income tax returns (Italian Tax Return Form – Modello Unico Persone Fisiche );
Maintaining accurate accounting records and bookkeeping activities;
Managing VAT returns and settlements;
Handling ongoing tax and administrative compliance requirements throughout the year.
Come As You Are – Your Skills and Qualifications
This opportunity is ideal for you if you:
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field;
Have a good knowledge of tax regulations applicable to self-employed individuals (VAT-registered professionals);
Are highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly advanced Excel functions;
Possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills;
Enjoy working in a team and have strong problem-solving abilities;
Demonstrate strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Your Future With Us – What You’ll Find at KPMG
An inclusive and fair workplace that respects, encourages, and values diversity;
A stimulating and dynamic environment that fosters creativity and teamwork;
A hybrid working model designed to support a healthy work-life balance;
Advanced training and development programs to help you stay up to date and continue growing;
An international mindset and exposure to innovative projects;
Initiatives focused on physical and mental well-being.
Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, level IV°. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including the candidate’s skills, relevant experience and fulfilment of the requirements of the position.
In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.
Together for Better – Our Values and Commitment
Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community, and integrity: these are KPMG’s Values. They create an environment that encourages the exchange of ideas and knowledge, enabling our professionals to fully express their potential.
Through our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace, our Network has achieved ISO 30415 certification , recognizing compliance with Diversity and Inclusion Management Systems, and UNI/PdR 125 certification , which acknowledges our commitment to gender equality.
Within our Impact Plan – bit.ly/OurImpactPlanKPMG – you can find a summary of the concrete actions we are taking across environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives.
Join us!

Full-time Europe Milan
apply
Job Description
Job description
As a Senior Process Analyst in KOS PLAN & DELIVERY Europe, you will lead complex planning and logistics improvement initiatives. You will combine supply-chain and logistics expertise, investment and profitability analysis, functional leadership and hands-on implementation to help manufacturing organizations achieve measurable and sustainable results. You will move confidently between strategic planning, detailed logistics process understanding and collaboration with client and operational teams.
Key responsibilities
· Lead continuous-improvement projects focused on logistics performance, including OTIF improvement, WIP optimisation and logistics-cost reduction.
· Diagnose logistics and planning performance gaps, establish improvement targets and define implementation roadmaps.
· Design and improve Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes, governance, decision forums and planning routines.
· Evaluate the profitability and business impact of logistics investments in hardware and software, including costs, benefits, risks and expected returns.
· Manage Logistics and Planning teams, or lead consulting projects in these functional areas.
· Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Production, Procurement, Warehousing, Logistics and Finance.
· Use planning data and key legacy IT systems to support fact-based decisions, planning reliability and performance management.
· Understand and apply the functional use of key IT systems supporting Planning.
· Facilitate structured problem solving, workshops, performance reviews and management discussions.
· Coach and develop less experienced team members in analytical methods, improvement approaches and stakeholder management.
· Prepare clear business cases, executive-level recommendations, implementation plans and progress updates.
· Ensure improvements are implemented sustainably and embedded into management routines, planning processes and operating standards.
Who you are
We are looking for a collaborative, curious and practical problem-solver who can connect analytical findings with real operational conditions. You bring:
· 4–6 years of professional experience in a manufacturing company or in operations consulting.
· Demonstrated experience delivering continuous-improvement projects in logistics, including OTIF improvement, WIP optimisation and logistics-cost reduction.
· Strong knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning principles, processes, governance and decision-making routines.
· The ability to perform profitability analyses for logistics investments in hardware and software, including business-case development and return assessment.
· Experience managing Logistics and/or Planning teams, or leading consulting projects in these functional areas.
· Knowledge of the functional use of key IT systems supporting Planning.
· A strong understanding of planning, warehouse, internal logistics, inventory and supply-chain performance management.
· The ability to connect operational, technological and financial perspectives when defining improvement priorities.
· Leadership, influencing and communication skills, with a structured, results-oriented and collaborative approach.
· Curiosity and the ability to quickly understand new technologies, processes and industrial environments.
· English proficiency at a minimum C1 level.
What we offer
· Early responsibility and hands-on opportunities to work with manufacturing and operational teams across Europe.
· Structured, on-the-job learning and development, supported by experienced colleagues and continuous feedback.
· An open, collaborative and international environment where diverse perspectives are valued.
· The opportunity to build expertise across industries, processes and technologies while making a practical impact.
· A culture that encourages you to be yourself and bring your ideas to the table.
Apply now
Please submit your CV through the Kearney careers website. Your application should highlight the experience and capabilities most relevant to the role.
Interview process
Candidates selected for the next stage will be contacted with details of the interview process.

Job Description
As a Business Analyst at Kearney , you will contribute to consulting project teams as they offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients. Depending on each client’s unique needs, projects can differ in length, size, and location, giving you unique, hands-on experiences across a range of industries and service practices.
Working alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people, you will broaden your knowledge and experience in an open, agile, and collaborative environment. With the freedom to be yourself and recognition for what you bring to the table, you can put your purpose into action and help build a future that works for everyone, everywhere - as a Kearney Original.
Key responsibilities
Ensure the success of projects by completing tasks such as gathering and analyzing data and conducting competitor assessment studies.
Support project workstreams and teams as you work alongside clients to create recommendations and implement co-created solutions.
Assist the firm’s business development through generating proposals.
Contribute to the development of thought leadership and other internal and external reports and articles.
Participate in firm building opportunities, e.g. recruiting, training, and mentoring.
Who you are
After nearly 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who do not accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.
We want to hear from you if you are:
Ready to share your ideas and contribute as soon as you join a team
Analytically inclined and enjoy solving problems
Able to prioritize and are a doer by nature
Looking to kick-start your career in consulting
In your final year of your degree
Fluent in English
What we can offer you
Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:
Generous retirement/pension savings contributions
Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families
Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities
Personalized opportunities, including talent mobility, flexible work programs, and externships to help you chart a unique career journey to pursue your own personal and professional goals
Read more about our benefits and how you can a make your mark, your way at Kearney.com/careers.
Apply now
Fill in the online form and upload your CV and cover letter (.doc or .pdf format only) . Applications will close on Tuesday 27th October 2026
Please note
Screening of applications will happen on a rolling basis
You will receive an email to let you know that your application has been received
Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination
Kearney prides itself on providing a culture that allows employees to bring their best selves to work every day. Our people can feel comfortable, confident, and joyful to do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients.
That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse, unbiased, and inclusive workforce. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. Members of communities historically underrepresented in consulting are encouraged to apply.

Associate
Who are we
As a global consulting partnership in more than 40 countries, our people make us who we are. We’re individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with. Over the years we’ve fostered a culture in which we are united by shared values—passion, solidarity, generosity, curiosity and boldness—and these come alive in the work we do and how we do it.
Together, we know our people are our difference—for our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. That’s why we take pride in being individual and inclusive and create a place where everyone can bring their full self to work.
Make your mark as an Associate at Kearney
Are you ready to:
Work alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?
Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?
Join a company which prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?
Be the difference and make it happen?
If so, we are ready to help you:
Discover. Collaborating with our clients across a range of industries and service practices, our people are always learning. At Kearney, you will broaden your knowledge and experience across a breadth of areas, no matter your role. Being rooted in expertise, we know our people deserve opportunities to go places and further their exposure to the business world.
Grow. We believe in the power of apprenticeship. At Kearney, you work alongside colleagues who help you be the best you can be. Through both, our structured programs and apprenticeship model, you will continue to learn and develop every day. After all, we are here to help you not just perform, but to thrive in your career.
Be yourself. At Kearney, we give you the freedom to contribute creatively while you also pursue your dreams. We want you to bring your whole self to work and to find joy in what you do. That’s why we support our people when they want to let their uniqueness show and offer personalized opportunities including tuition support, flexible work programs, and externships.
Who you are
If you’re reading this, you’re smart enough to already know what we’re looking for. Insightful, yes. Inquisitive, naturally. Collaborative, of course. But we’re also looking for problem-solvers who think further than that, who don’t accept the first thing in front of them, and who are always unapologetically themselves.
This business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies and above all, people. That’s why we expect you to be:
Analytically inclined and love solving problems
Ready to share your ideas and opinions as soon as you join a team
Experienced in your chosen field
In your final year of or hold an MBA degree
Fluent in English
What We Seek
There is no standard model for Kearney associates. We look for talented problem-solvers with intellectual curiosity who are ready to be active members of a client team. Associates are typically involved in every phase of an engagement, from pre-proposal research to final implementation. The following qualifications are preferred:
‒ A proven record of academic excellence
‒ Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
‒ Strong critical thinking and analytical capabilities
‒ An innovative and collaborative approach to problem-solving
‒ Natural self-direction, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and learn quickly
‒ Eagerness to collaborate, coach, mentor, and help others grow professionally
‒ Four to eight years’ success in a rigorous environment, such as a global or Fortune 500 company or consulting firm
To apply please fill in the online form and upload your CV and cover letter. There is no need for any other documents
This position is for the London office only.
Applications will close: Tuesday 27th October 2026
Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination
Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Job Description
Job description
As a Senior Process Analyst in KOS MAKE Europe, you will lead complex manufacturing and operational-improvement initiatives. You will combine industrial engineering expertise, investment and profitability analysis, functional leadership and hands-on implementation to help manufacturing organizations achieve measurable and sustainable results. You will move confidently between strategic analysis, detailed process understanding and collaboration with client and operational teams.
Key responsibilities
· Lead continuous-improvement projects focused on labour efficiency and/or Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
· Diagnose operational performance gaps, establish improvement targets and define implementation roadmaps.
· Support the industrialization of new products and/or processes, from process definition through implementation and stabilization.
· Evaluate the profitability and business impact of industrial investments, including costs, benefits, risks and expected returns.
· Manage Production, Maintenance and Quality teams, or lead consulting projects in these functional areas.
· Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and align operational priorities, technical solutions and business objectives.
· Use manufacturing data and key legacy IT systems to support fact-based decisions and performance management.
· Understand and apply the functional use of manufacturing systems such as SCADA, MES and PLM.
· Facilitate structured problem solving, workshops, performance reviews and management discussions.
· Coach and develop less experienced team members in analytical methods, improvement approaches and stakeholder management.
· Prepare clear business cases, executive-level recommendations, implementation plans and progress updates.
· Ensure improvements are implemented sustainably and embedded into management routines and operating standards.
Who you are
We are looking for a collaborative, curious and practical problem-solver who can connect analytical findings with real operational conditions. You bring:
· 4–6 years of professional experience in a manufacturing company or in operations consulting.
· Demonstrated experience delivering continuous-improvement projects related to labour efficiency and/or Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
· Experience with the industrialization of new products and/or processes.
· The ability to perform profitability analyses for industrial investments, including business-case development and return assessment.
· Experience managing Production, Maintenance and/or Quality teams, or leading consulting projects in these functional areas.
· Knowledge of the functional use of manufacturing systems such as SCADA, MES and PLM.
· A strong understanding of manufacturing processes, operational performance management and implementation challenges.
· The ability to connect operational, technical and financial perspectives when defining improvement priorities.
· Leadership, influencing and communication skills, with a structured, results-oriented and collaborative approach.
· Curiosity and the ability to quickly understand new technologies, processes and industrial environments.
· English proficiency at a minimum C1 level.
What we offer
· Early responsibility and hands-on opportunities to work with manufacturing and operational teams across Europe.
· Structured, on-the-job learning and development, supported by experienced colleagues and continuous feedback.
· An open, collaborative and international environment where diverse perspectives are valued.
· The opportunity to build expertise across industries, processes and technologies while making a practical impact.
· A culture that encourages you to be yourself and bring your ideas to the table.
Apply now
Please submit your CV through the Kearney careers website. Your application should highlight the experience and capabilities most relevant to the role.
Interview process
Candidates selected for the next stage will be contacted with details of the interview process.

Amazon::10569387.title: Sr Product Manager, Tax Engine
Amazon::10569387.text:
Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.
That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr Product Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.
We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.
Key job responsibilities

Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document printing product.
Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
Manage product planning and feature prioritization through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.
A day in the life
As a Sr Product Manager in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify features for our document printing product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of products for the Tax Services organization.

Amazon::10569944.text:
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS), and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? Technical Account Managers (TAM) drive our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies - including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises in commercial and public sector.
The Role
As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services - including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management.
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success.
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
You’ll advise on solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C-suite executives
* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
* With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
* Provide detailed reviews of service events, monthly & quarterly metrics, detailed pre-launch planning
* Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
Experience in technical engineering
Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings

Amazon::10570127.text:
Do you get a thrill out of closing a good deal? Do you have specific experience building massively-scaled networks? Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon.com as a key technology platform provider? If this describes you, how would you like to own driving the deals and help decide our strategy as we grow?
This Technical Business Development role is open for a Contract Negotiator. This candidate will assume responsibilities for handling Amazon’s relationships with IP service providers in the European, Middle East, and African interconnection markets to meet scaling goals, supporting customer demand.
As a Technical Business Developer for Internet Services, you will play an important role in planning and sourcing IP interconnect and peering capacity in close coordination with other team members. You will respond to peering requests, sourcing and negotiating peering and transit connections to ISPs, assist in establishing peering with partner networks at new Internet exchanges globally, and work closely with network operations teams to ensure that peering and transit connections are upgraded in a timely and effective manner. The ideal candidate will be excited about the incredible opportunity cloud computing represents and will be passionate about building great teams that deliver high quality services. You will be customer focused and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that requires strong technical and business judgment and great communication skills.
Key job responsibilities
Serve as a subject matter expert with regards to “eyeball” IP networks within your region.
Organize, track, and coordinate with vendors and internal teams to deliver new IP interconnect capacity for Amazon.
Develop interconnect capacity plans to enable effective, efficient and scalable delivery of Amazon content to users.
Assist in establishing peering with partner networks at new interconnect facilities globally, and work closely with network operations teams to ensure that peering and transit connections are upgraded in a timely and effective manner.
Continually negotiate improved interconnection business relationships with external network providers.
Collaborate with a wide variety of internal teams including business development, legal, and deployment, to successfully implement strategic plans.
Willingness and ability to travel frequently to site visits and team meetings.
A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
